mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals robust residential construction activity and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings prospects improve without requiring additional regime conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0%, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as liquidity conditions deteriorate.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or Rank IC remains negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profit margins, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through interaction effects.
failure_condition: The joint effect of UNRATE decline and PAYEMS increase fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or interaction term coefficient is negative with p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO), manufacturing sector weakness signals reduced corporate output and potential earnings contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic slowdown expectations intensify.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines > 0.5% in 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals persistent inflation that triggers central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as real interest rates rise and equity valuations contract without regime-specific conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL increases by at least 0.3% month-over-month, or Rank IC remains negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 5.0%, it signals economic weakness and reduced consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market sentiment deteriorates through a threshold-triggered mechanism.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint increase in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals robust economic activity that accelerates corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through interaction effects.
failure_condition: The joint effect of RSAFS and HOUST increases fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or interaction term coefficient is negative with p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong economic growth (GDPC1 growth exceeding 3.0% quarter-over-quarter), consumer demand expansion accelerates corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as market expectations adjust to robust expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth exceeds 3.0% quarter-over-quarter, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
